```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, ready_for_review, reopened]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 * * * *' # Run every hour

jobs:
  claude-code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency: claude-code-review-${{ github.ref }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: true
          access_token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Set up Anthropic API key
        run: echo "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run Claude Code Review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: ""
          assignee_trigger: ""
          label_trigger: ""
          base_branch: main
          branch_prefix: ""
          branch_name_template: ""
          allowed_bots: []
          allowed_non_write_users: []
          include_comments_by_actor: false
          exclude_comments_by_actor: false
          prompt: |
            Review this pull request for correctness, design, readability, performance, security, testing, and product considerations.
          settings: '{"temperature": 0.7}'
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          anthropic_federation_rule_id: ""

      - name: Post review feedback
        if: steps.claude-code-review.outputs.conclusion == 'success'
        run: |
          gh pr comment ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --body-file .cursor/commands/review-pr.md
```
